checks.name: content-smoke
checks.command: pwsh.exe -NoProfile -Command $actual = git show HEAD:steerline-spec03-supervised-stage.txt; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $actual.Trim() -ne 'spec03-supervised-stage-v1') { exit 7 }; exit 0

command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $branch=git branch --show-current; git push -u origin HEAD; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $existing=gh pr list --repo erranliu/SteerlineTest --head $branch --state all --json url --jq '.[].url'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; if($existing){Write-Output $existing; exit 0}; gh pr create --repo erranliu/SteerlineTest --draft --base main --head $branch --title ('Spec 03 acceptance '+$branch) --body 'Isolated SteerLine Spec 03 remote execution acceptance; verified test-only commit.'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
